title: Whole Garden Equipment Preparation Corner
description: One complete static garden-equipment preparation corner, one scene and zero new models. A whole original open worktable at the rear-left supports the entire qualified twin-comb trimmer turned through one exact quarter turn, keeping its original case, both complete hand openings, guard and complete comb head. An entire backframe blower stands separately at front-left with its original straps and full hose/nozzle. A whole wheeled chipper occupies the separate right floor station with all wheels, parking feet, side open feed and tall elbow retained. The elevated long-tool bench, wearable-equipment parking and separate feed-side equipment envelope frame an empty front approach. This is not the earlier foreground horizontal splitting machine with rear log shelter and barrow, nor the paired cleaning-equipment bays. Four complete original unit-scale models retain every raw GLB buffer, local normal, internal hierarchy and per-face PBR. Only whole rigid wrappers and one finite scene-only support floor are new. No components are extracted, resized, recoloured or counted as new models. Static artistic empty equipment display only; no trimming, feeding, chipping, air flow, operation, material flow, human reach, fit, access compliance, loading, stability or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction are not made.
